commands.checks: Compile both C engines; replay reduced n=1..6 and independent n=2..5 calibration counts; pure-Python brute force for n<=4 matching both engines, with every solution orbit met by the reduced census; PR4232's 405-call seven-source word; positive, negative and shard-partition controls.
Reduced-engine n=7 census shards 0,1 of 18: zero floor paths and leaf counts equal to CERTIFICATE.json. A sample of the census; the complete census is the opt-in --n7-all replay.
Reduced-engine n=7 census shards 8,9 of 18: zero floor paths and leaf counts equal to CERTIFICATE.json. A sample of the census; the complete census is the opt-in --n7-all replay.
Reduced-engine n=7 census shards 16,17 of 18: zero floor paths and leaf counts equal to CERTIFICATE.json. A sample of the census; the complete census is the opt-in --n7-all replay.

notes: Requires a C11 compiler named cc. The 1200 s package replay cap holds six of the 18 reduced-engine shards. The complete reduced census (about 1350 CPU seconds; {python} -B {package}/verify.py --n7-all) and the independent-engine census (about 12.5 minutes wall on 18 cores; --n7-independent) are opt-in (--n7-independent also replays the independent n=6 calibration) and compare against the per-shard leaf counts in CERTIFICATE.json.
